book_verdict: This reader does not expand the abbreviations reliably. On all three pages negations and the sed/ergo/quam connectives are lost, which reverses arguments ("si est anima", "communi discordia", the natural-law conclusion) and drops whole clauses. A Latinist would not trust it.

book_verdict: A largely competent expansion of the abbreviated incunable that a reader could follow, with one argument-reversing negation slip on p.199 and the key necessity distinction garbled on p.395. Several connectives and terms are misread.

book_verdict: The strongest of the three: abbreviations are expanded accurately, including the contra/conclusio markers, Aristotle's Politics, and the necessitas consequentie distinction. A few moderate misreads remain on p.199. The only on-sight flag is a model <note> left inside the p.199 text; there is no serious error.
